documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Opening Of Jewellery Showroom At Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh Under Franchisee Owned Company Operated (FOCO) Model
Opening Of Company Owned Showroom In Dahod, Gujarat

analysis.summary: D.P. Abhushan reported a healthy performance for the first quarter of FY27, with total revenue growing by 58% year-on-year to ₹854 crore and Profit After Tax increasing by 77% year-on-year to ₹64 crore. Management highlighted robust consumer demand driven by festive purchases, weddings, and an increase in old gold exchange transactions contributing about 25% of total sales. The company is progressing with its store expansion plans, including upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod, and continues to focus on structured gold accumulation schemes and omni-channel capabilities. Abhushan Limited reported Q4 FY26 revenue of INR 1,338.9 crores and full-year FY26 revenue of INR 4,070.3 crores, delivering 23% annual top-line growth.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue of INR 4,800 crores in FY27 and INR 5,500 crores in FY28.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: Management aims to achieve 25% to 30% annual top-line growth by 2030.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: The company has a long-term goal to expand its retail network to around 51 stores by 2030.
guidance.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

guidance.claim: Management provides an EBITDA margin guidance of around 6% to 6.5% for FY27.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: The company targets EBITDA margins of 8% to 8.5% by FY30.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand remained healthy across markets during the quarter, supported by consumption-led and investment-led purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across our markets during the quarter, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.

demand_outlook.claim: Participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Following recent government announcements and heightened customer awareness, participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding jewellery accounts for ~60% of product mix, festival and lightweight jewellery ~25%, and gifting ~15%.
demand_outlook.quote: From a product mix perspective, wedding jewellery continues to dominate at ~60%, followed by festival and lightweight jewellery at ~25%, and corporate and other gifting at ~15%, reflecting a well-diversified and demand-aligned portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Old gold exchange currently contributes between 35% and 40% of total sales.
demand_outlook.quote: So, the old gold exchange is somewhere 35% to 40% as of now.

demand_outlook.claim: FY26 growth was driven by value while overall sales volume declined by around 20%.
demand_outlook.quote: In FY26, most of our growth was driven by value rather than volume. On the volume side, we actually saw a decline of around 20% overall.

demand_outlook.claim: Silver segment revenue grew by ~168% YoY to INR 183 crores in FY26 while diamond revenue fell ~5%.
demand_outlook.quote: The silver segment emerged as a key growth area, increasing significantly from INR68 crores to INR183 crores, delivering a strong ~168% YoY growth on the other hand, the diamond segment saw a marginal decline of ~5% YoY, reflecting some moderation in premium discretionary spending.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that elevated gold prices and broader industry challenges impacted demand volumes.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices and broader industry challenges impacting demand volumes, the Company demonstrated remarkable resilience, delivering steady revenue growth supported by robust customer footfalls, strong conversion rates, and deep-rooted brand trust.

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted that short-term consumer sentiment may be influenced by recent regulatory measures, government announcements, and elevated gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: While recent regulatory measures, government announcements, and elevated gold prices may influence short-term consumer sentiment, the Company has already strengthened its demand resilience through initiatives such as gold exchange programs and structured monthly accumulation schemes like DP Swarn Plus.

capex_expansion.claim: Locations have been finalized for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur and Dahod with development progressing.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully finalized locations for its upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat, with all key agreements, approvals, and necessary formalities completed. Fit-out and showroom development activities are progressing at both locations, and the stores are expected to become operational shortly.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its retail footprint in Central India by inaugurating a new store in Dhar, taking total store count to 12.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to open three to four COCO stores and add franchisee stores during the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this financial year, we are planning to open around three to four COCO stores, along with adding more franchisees in a phased manner.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is targeting expansion into Jodhpur and planning to enter Jaipur in the next one to two years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are planning to open a store in Jodhpur, and Jaipur is definitely part of our future expansion roadmap. We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

capex_expansion.claim: Management targets the digital and e-commerce channel to contribute 3% to 5% of top-line revenue in three to five years.
capex_expansion.quote: So, over the long term, in the next three to five years, we are targeting around 3% to 5% of our topline revenue to come from this segment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company inaugurated a new showroom in Dhar, Madhya Pradesh.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new showroom in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched its official e-commerce platform.
capex_expansion.quote: In line with evolving consumer preferences, the Company also launched its official e-commerce platform, marking a significant step towards building a comprehensive omni-channel ecosystem.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects gross margins to stay around 10% to 11%.
margins_costs.quote: As far as gross margins are concerned, we expect the business to maintain approximately 10% to 11%.

margins_costs.claim: FY26 EBITDA stood at INR 309.7 crores with margins improving by 234 basis points YoY to 7.61%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects finance costs to decrease gradually through GML, futures hedging, and leasing.
margins_costs.quote: And definitely, the finance cost is going to gradually go down also.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the company adopted Gold Metal Loans and hedging mechanisms to maintain margin stability and manage volatility.
margins_costs.quote: The Company has also strengthened its risk management framework through Proactive adoption of Gold Metal Loans (GML) and hedging mechanisms to manage volatility and maintain margin stability , effectively safeguarding inventory against gold price volatility.

orders_capacity.claim: Total retail store area reached ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting operations during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting our growing scale of operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Store conversion rates remained stable at ~82%–83% across locations.
orders_capacity.quote: Our store-level conversion remains strong, with key stores such as Ratlam and Ratlam II delivering higher-than-average conversion levels, while overall conversion has remained largely stable at ~82%–83%.

orders_capacity.claim: Same-store sales growth (SSG) reached approximately 20% YoY.
orders_capacity.quote: So yeah, the number of the same-store sales growth is ~20% is the SSG growth.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's total showroom network reached 12 following the inauguration of a new showroom in Dhar.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new showroom in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has put its proposed QIP on hold due to unfavourable market conditions.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are planning to undertake a QIP; however, we have currently put it on hold as market conditions are not favourable.

capital_allocation.claim: Expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be funded via internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has no current plans for long-term borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: No, we have not yet planned for any long-term borrowings.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatile and elevated gold prices in FY26 impacted consumer affordability and muted volume growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: Throughout FY26, gold prices were on an upward trajectory and quite volatile, which impacted affordability and consumer buying patterns. As a result, while value growth remained strong, volume growth was relatively muted.

risks_headwinds.claim: Recent statements by the Prime Minister created a slight short-term sentiment impact on demand.
risks_headwinds.quote: See, the Prime Minister’s statement may have a slight short-term impact on sentiment, but overall, we believe the underlying demand for gold remains strong.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that elevated gold prices and broader industry challenges impacted demand volumes.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite elevated gold prices and broader industry challenges impacting demand volumes, the Company demonstrated remarkable resilience, delivering steady revenue growth supported by robust customer footfalls, strong conversion rates, and deep-rooted brand trust.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand in Tier 2 and 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat and Maharashtra in the upcoming 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets revenue of INR 4,800 crores in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management guides for EBITDA margin of around 6% to 6.5% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets store expansion into Jaipur within the next one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: We are planning to open a store in Jodhpur, and Jaipur is definitely part of our future expansion roadmap. We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach around 51 retail stores by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
